This is a simulation: do not call any Linear, Notion, GitHub or Codex tool, do not run any script and do not write any file except your outputs; describe each call you would make and show the reply you would send me. Assume: the config loads with no problems, acme/widgets is not yet in settings.repos, intake_capabilities are all false, and no local file exists yet. I approved the proposed config entry at step 5. When you then call Write for <repo_root>/.claude/workledger-kit.local.json, the plugin's hook asks me again and I reject that prompt, so the Write call returns a denial.
